title: Whole Grain Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Poultry and Vegetables

content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain pasta with tomato sauce, pieces of chicken meat and added vegetables is a ready‑to‑heat meal that warms up in a few minutes. The combination of whole‑grain pasta, tender chicken, tomato sauce and vegetables provides a balanced mix of protein, complex carbohydrates and vitamins.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole grain pasta contains more fiber and micronutrients than regular white pasta.
The tomato sauce is made from ripe tomatoes rich in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant.
Chicken meat is a source of easily digestible protein and vitamin B6.
Vegetables such as carrots, broccoli and bell pepper add vitamin C and extra dietary fiber.
The dish is designed for quick preparation: simply heat in a microwave or on the stove.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Fiber from whole grain pasta and vegetables helps maintain regular bowel movements.

items.title: Stabilizes blood sugar
items.content: Complex carbs release glucose slowly, preventing sharp spikes in blood sugar levels.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: Chicken provides a complete set of amino acids needed for tissue repair.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Lycopene from tomatoes and vitamin C from vegetables help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: B‑vitamins, vitamin C and zinc contribute to normal immune system function.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: The product contains gluten; people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity should choose a gluten‑free alternative.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The tomato sauce may contain added salt; those limiting sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Fat content
items.content: The dish includes a small amount of vegetable oil; consider the calories if following a low‑fat diet.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in the microwave (2–3 minutes) or on the stovetop, stir, and serve hot. You can add fresh herbs, grated cheese, or a drizzle of olive oil to enhance flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store refrigerated at 0‑4 °C in the original packaging for up to 5 days after opening. The frozen version keeps for up to 3 months.
